strongest_bear_case: 2025 high-end HDI mix and a concentrated AI customer drove an exceptional margin and profit step-up just as the company committed to a very large capacity cycle. After the rapid August rebound, A/H still mechanically trade near 60x/46x TTM earnings. If platform timing, qualification yield, customer allocation or pricing normalizes before new plants reach efficient utilization, fixed costs and capex can compress free cash flow while the share price still embeds high growth.
